# Every public header must compile on its own.
#
# A header that only works because some OTHER header was included first is a
# landmine for downstream: our own tests include <actor-zeta.hpp> first, which
# hides the problem. downstream includes detail/behavior_t.hpp directly, and
# that is how two of its translation units stopped building.
#
# One translation unit per header, generated by walking the tree, so a newly
# added header is covered without anyone remembering to list it here.

set(CURRENT_TEST_NAME tests_header_selfsufficiency)

file(GLOB_RECURSE AZ_PUBLIC_HEADERS
        RELATIVE "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/header"
        CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
        "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/header/*.hpp")

if (NOT AZ_PUBLIC_HEADERS)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "header-selfsufficiency: found no headers to check")
endif ()

set(${CURRENT_TEST_NAME}_SOURCES "")
set(AZ_GENERATED_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")

foreach (AZ_HEADER IN LISTS AZ_PUBLIC_HEADERS)
    string(REGEX REPLACE "[/.]" "_" AZ_SLUG "${AZ_HEADER}")
    set(AZ_TU "${AZ_GENERATED_DIR}/selfsufficiency_${AZ_SLUG}.cpp")
    file(CONFIGURE
            OUTPUT "${AZ_TU}"
            CONTENT "// generated -- do not edit\n#include <${AZ_HEADER}>\n"
            @ONLY)
    list(APPEND ${CURRENT_TEST_NAME}_SOURCES "${AZ_TU}")
endforeach ()

list(APPEND ${CURRENT_TEST_NAME}_SOURCES main.cpp)

add_executable(${CURRENT_TEST_NAME} ${${CURRENT_TEST_NAME}_SOURCES})

target_link_libraries(
        ${CURRENT_TEST_NAME} PRIVATE
        actor-zeta
)

set_target_properties(${CURRENT_TEST_NAME}
        PROPERTIES
        CXX_STANDARD ${CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD}
        CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED YES
        CXX_EXTENSIONS NO
)

add_test(NAME ${CURRENT_TEST_NAME} COMMAND ${CURRENT_TEST_NAME})
